analysis: The PR modifies only docs/architecture/inference.md. Visible changed lines: the scheduler configuration table around base 1087-1088 and head 1087-1090, plus head ranges 1100-1146 and 2028-2041 whose patch is truncated and not visible. The table change documents wider prefill chunk defaults (2048 chunk / 4096 step for GPT-OSS, dense Qwen3.5/3.8 and Gemma 4), removal of the solo prefill stripe for those families, and a new bidirectionalMediaPrefillChunkCeiling of 512. This is documentation only and changes no code, so no control in the threat model is weakened. The base text I was given describes prefix cache, deadlines, MTP and media handling in ways consistent with T-041 and the existing TB-007 posture. I verified no changes to the SSD prefix cache TTL, HMAC lookup tags, salt scoping or encryption. Open questions for integration: (1) the doc describes code changes in EngineV2Factory+Configuration.swift and CBv2Contracts.swift that are not in this batch, so the wider prefill chunk behavior (memory use, availability under T-010 and T-029, and any effect on prefix-cache block alignment for T-041) was not reviewed. (2) The head ranges 1100-1146 and 2028-2041 could not be inspected because the patch is truncated, so I cannot confirm they contain no security-relevant claims such as cache TTL, isolation, or attestation statements. No finding is raised, since there is no evidence of a regression, and needs_deeper_review is set because of the unseen head content and the unreviewed code changes behind this doc.
